f.title: Do not omit any point of the safety-document structure set by the guide
f.statement: Because the guide is based on NOM-220-SSA1-2016, none of the points of the structure it establishes for clinical-study pharmacovigilance documents shall be omitted.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, sponsor, investigator or person responsible for the clinical study
rows.quote:
4.1. La presente guía está elaborada con base en lo establecido en la NOM- 220-SSA1-2016,
Instalación y operación de la farmacovigilancia, por lo tanto, no se deberá omitir ninguno de
los puntos de la estructura establecida en esta guía.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; guide wording 'no se deberá omitir' = Mandatory although the norm type is Guidance. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Level follows 'no se deberá omitir'. Below 90: actor inferred (impersonal 'deberá'; the quote names no addressee; guide is addressed to MAHs, investigators, sponsors or study responsible persons); general structural rule rather than a discrete PV action.
rows.quote_en: 4.1. This guide is prepared on the basis of NOM-220-SSA1-2016, Installation and operation of pharmacovigilance; therefore none of the points of the structure established in this guide shall be omitted.

f.title: Submit clinical-study PV information electronically as PDF in Spanish
f.statement: Clinical-study pharmacovigilance information shall be submitted electronically, in PDF format and in Spanish. The guide applies only to clinical studies that have a research site in Mexico.
f.applicability: Clinical studies with at least one research site in Mexico

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, sponsor, investigator or person responsible for the clinical study
rows.quote:
4.2. La información deberá someterse de manera electrónica (en formato PDF), idioma en
español y solo aplicará para los estudios clínicos que cuenten con un Centro de Investigación
en México.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Level follows 'deberá someterse'. Below 90: actor inferred (impersonal 'deberá'; the quote names no addressee; guide is addressed to MAHs, investigators, sponsors or study responsible persons).
rows.quote_en: 4.2. The information shall be submitted electronically (in PDF format), in Spanish, and shall only apply to clinical studies that have a research site in Mexico.

f.title: Comply with all NOM-220 pharmacovigilance activities for clinical studies
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders or their legal representatives in Mexico shall comply with all pharmacovigilance activities that NOM-220-SSA1-2016 establishes for clinical studies.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder or its legal representative in Mexico
rows.quote:
4.3. Los titulares del registro sanitario o sus representantes legales en México, deberán de
dar cumplimiento a todas las actividades de farmacovigilancia que establece NOM-220-
SSA1-2016, Instalación y operación de la farmacovigilancia referente a estudios clínicos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit (titulares del registro sanitario o representantes legales), 'deberán' = Mandatory, statement adds nothing.

f.title: Notify delegated clinical-study PV activities through one party only
f.statement: Where pharmacovigilance activities for a clinical study have been delegated by mutual agreement to the research site conducting the study, the activities shall be notified by only one of the parties so that information is not duplicated.
f.applicability: PV activities delegated to the research site by mutual agreement

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder and research site
rows.quote:
En
caso de que dichas actividades sean delegadas al Centro de Investigación que esté llevando
a cabo el estudio y esto haya sido de común acuerdo, las actividades deberán ser notificadas
solo por una de las partes con la finalidad de que no se duplique la información.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. rows.quote_en: Where those activities are delegated to the research site conducting the study and this has been by mutual agreement, the activities shall be notified by only one of the parties so that the information is not duplicated.

f.title: Count annual safety report periodicity from first national study authorisation
f.statement: The periodicity of delivery of a clinical study's annual safety report runs from the first national authorisation of the study, as established in item 8.3.3.3.1 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016.

rows.deadline: Annual, counted from the first national authorisation of the study

de seguridad anual de un estudio clínico se establece a partir de la primera autorización
nacional del estudio, como lo establece el numeral 8.3.3.3.1. NOM-220-SSA1-2016, Instalación
y operación de la farmacovigilancia.

f.statement: Clinical studies carried out in Health Institutes that are authorised by COFEPRIS shall comply with this guide.

f.title: File clinical-study PV procedures by free-form letter to the COFEPRIS CIS
f.statement: Clinical-study pharmacovigilance procedures shall be submitted by free-form letter to the COFEPRIS Integral Service Centre (CIS), addressed to the Executive Director of Pharmacopoeia and Pharmacovigilance.

f.title: State the procedure type and the NOM-220 item in the submission letter
f.statement: The submission letter shall state the type of procedure being submitted (notice of authorisation; notice of cancellation, suspension, discontinuation and/or resumption of clinical studies; annual follow-up safety report; notice of completion of the clinical stage; final safety report) and the regulatory background, naming the item of NOM-220-SSA1-2016 under which the document is submitted.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, sponsor, investigator or person responsible for the clinical study
rows.quote:
Tipo de trámite especificar el tipo de tramite a someter (aviso de autorización, aviso
  de cancelación, suspensión, descontinuación y/o reanudación de los estudios clínicos,
  reporte de seguridad de seguimiento anual, aviso de finalización de la etapa clínica,
  reporte de seguridad final).
 Antecedente regulatorio deberá nombrar bajo qué numeral de la NOM-220-SSA1-
  2016, Instalación y operación de la farmacovigilancia se está sometiendo el documento.
data_elements: PV responsible person and unit details

f.statement: Where information requested in the tables is not available, a line shall be drawn to show the table is cancelled; where there is no information for a section, the absence shall be justified.

f.title: Analyse results including benefit/risk factors in the final safety report
f.statement: The analysis of results of the final safety report shall include an overall evaluation of the results obtained during the study, including comorbidities, concomitant treatments or other factors that help explain the results relating to the benefit/risk evaluation; it shall also describe and detail the discussion of observations made throughout the study with the logical deduction from the data that shows the research result.

otros factores que permitan explicar los resultados referentes a la evaluación del balance
beneficio /riesgo.

También se deberá describir y detallar la discusión de las observaciones realizadas a lo largo
del estudio, en donde se presente la deducción lógica de los datos obtenidos que permiten
mostrar el resultado de la investigación.

f.statement: The start of any type of study (phase I, II, III or bioequivalence) shall not be notified to the CNFV, as it is not an activity established in NOM-220-SSA1-2016; that information shall be placed in the annual or final report as appropriate.

f.title: Submit the final safety report on study completion or definitive stop
f.statement: The final safety report shall be filed with the CNFV: on completion of a study that included at least one research site in Mexico; in the case of cancellation, discontinuation or definitive suspension of the study; and on completion of a bioequivalence, bioavailability and pharmacokinetics study.

     en México.
   En el caso de cancelación, descontinuación o suspensión definitiva del estudio.
